new = (root / path).read_text()
anchor = '\\begin{lemma}[Auxiliary estimates for the paired subline overlap]'


def split_node(text):
    start = text.index(anchor)
    end = text.index('\\end{proof}', start) + len('\\end{proof}')
    return text[:start], text[start:end], text[end:]


before_old, old_node, after_old = split_node(old)
before_new, new_node, after_new = split_node(new)
assert before_old == before_new and after_old == after_new

statement, proof = new_node.split('\\end{lemma}')

assert strip_uses(old_statement) == strip_uses(statement)
statement_uses = re.findall(r'\\uses\{([^}]*)\}', statement)
proof_uses = re.findall(r'\\uses\{([^}]*)\}', proof)
assert len(statement_uses) == len(proof_uses) == 1
statement_deps = [s.strip() for s in statement_uses[0].split(',')]

assert 'thm:qld-quarter-power-deficit-bound' in proof_deps

            'lem:qld-sublines-uniform-point', 'lem:restricted-line-mixture-bounds']:
    assert dep in proof_deps
index = citations.build_label_index(root)
for dep in statement_deps + proof_deps + ['lem:claim-17-2']:
    assert len(index[dep]) == 1, dep
entries = sync.collect_blueprint_entries(root / 'blueprint/src')
declarations = sync.collect_lean_decls(root / 'MIPStarRE')
target_labels = ['lem:paired-subline-overlap-estimates', 'lem:qld-x-point-overlap-deficit',
                 'thm:qld-quarter-power-deficit-bound']
starts = {index[label][0].start for label in target_labels}
relevant = [e for e in entries
            if e.file == 'src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex' and e.line in starts]
assert relevant and all(e.lean_decl in declarations for e in relevant)
assert all(e.has_leanok and e.proof_has_leanok for e in relevant)
tags = r'\\(?:lean\{[^}]*\}|leanok\b|notready\b)'
assert re.findall(tags, old) == re.findall(tags, new)
source_lemma = new[new.index('\\label{lem:qld-4-13}'):]
assert '\\notready' in source_lemma.split('\\end{lemma}')[0]
sha = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
sources = [path, 'references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex',
           'MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/SubLineXDeficit.lean',

           'MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/ErrorBounds.lean']

}, indent=2))
